_readme: Class-action settlements PerkScan matches against your receipts (by store and purchase dates).
Only add a settlement from its official settlement website or court notice: claim_url must be the
official claim site, and source_url + last_verified record where and when it was checked.
eligible_merchants are lowercase store names; a receipt matches when its store name contains one.
eligible_countries: [] means not limited by country. PerkScan links to the claim site and never files.
Then run: npm run seed:build, and load supabase/seed.sql (db push --include-seed or the SQL editor).
